name: Zygon Infiltrator
oracle_text: Body-print — {2}{U}: Tap another target creature and put a stun counter on it. This creature becomes a copy of that creature for as long as that creature remains tapped. Activate only as a sorcery. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
blocked_sentences: Body-print — {2}{U}: Tap another target creature and put a stun counter on it. This creature becomes a copy of that creature for as long as that creature remains tapped. Activate only as a sorcery

needs.what: a `become_copy` duration that lasts for as long as ANOTHER object (the copied target) remains tapped -- e.g. duration "while_tapped" with a selector/binding naming the watched permanent; the copy effect ends the moment that permanent untaps or leaves the battlefield
needs.why_existing_wont_do: op_become_copy honours only `end_of_turn` (cleared by clear_until_eot) and `permanent`; neither ends when the target untaps. `while_counter` exists on animate/cant_attack but watches counters on the affected object itself, not the tapped state of a different object, and `as_long_as_you_control_source` watches control of the source
